fixes: Subtitles on HLS downloads now show for the whole episode — the app used to stitch the server's ~6-second subtitle chunks together without shifting their clocks, so every line piled into the first seconds and nothing showed after that. Each chunk's lines are now placed at the right time in the episode.
A subtitle chunk that fails to load no longer kills the whole subtitle track — only that chunk's lines are lost and the rest stay in place.
